title: Children
eyebrow: Jesus said, “Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”
intro: Children are welcome to attend all services at Epiphany. Don't worry about noises or distractions. The congregation is thankful to be able to worship with children and includes them in the service whenever possible.

sections.heading: Sunday School
sections.text: Epiphany hosts a children's Sunday School once a month. Contact the church office for more information
